summary: Backend-only testing of new technician-mobile endpoints (timesheets, per-job time, checklist templates, materials catalog, voice notes, video upload, photo form fields, tenant isolation). All 38 pytest cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/timesheets.py: `list_my_shifts` uses `__import__('datetime').timedelta(...)` because `timedelta` isn't imported at module top — works but is ugly; please import `timedelta` directly.

routers/materials.py: stock decrement uses `int(body.qty or 0)` while qty is a float — fractional qty (e.g. 1.5) is silently truncated to 1 when decrementing stock. Consider rounding or rejecting fractional qty for stock-tracked items.
routers/materials.py: `update_material` / catalog endpoints don't currently log_activity (other CRUD does); minor inconsistency for audit trail.

routers/jobs.py videos: the 100MB size check happens AFTER `await file.read()` — a malicious 100MB+ payload is fully buffered into memory before rejection. Consider using `file.size` or streaming if available.

routers/checklists.py `update_template`: when items are provided in update body they come in as `ChecklistItemIn` (no `id` field on model), so existing item ids are always regenerated even though the code tries to preserve them via `i.get('id')`. Add `id: Optional[str]` to ChecklistItemIn to enable stable ids across edits.
routers/timesheets.py job_time_start: validates only this user's active log; two different users can run concurrent timers on the same job — that may be intended but worth confirming.
test_credentials: demo@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). A throwaway tenant is also registered each run for isolation tests (cleans itself up).
seed_data_creation: Per-run: 1 job (TEST_mobile_*), 1 checklist template (TEST_chk_*), 1 material (TEST_mat_*), 1 throwaway tenant for isolation. Templates/materials cleaned up via class-level fixture teardown; the test job and shift history rows are intentionally left behind for traceability (all prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile-app backend coverage lives in /app/backend/tests/test_mobile_endpoints.py (38 tests, all green). Estimates/invoicing tests from iteration 15 already cover the rest. The tiny mp4-bytes upload happy-path works against the current storage backend; if storage rejects it later, the test auto-skips on non-200. Video size cap is enforced AFTER read — keep that in mind if testing huge uploads.
